item.p: Specifications: XSLT 4.0, 26.2 "Disabling Output Escaping" (deprecated, optional, and its permission to drop the marker when the result is not serialized); Serialization 4.0, 2 (the phases).
Unlocks: XT40 disabling_output_escaping 32 (disable-output-escaping 28, bug 4, and others).
Replaces: today the attribute is read and ignored (src/xslt_read.c); the place where it is ignored is the place.

Mechanism (changed by , on the owner's prompt): a text node mark, as 's CDATA request, additive to tree.h (disables_output_escaping); the XML, XHTML and HTML methods write marked text unescaped. The JAXP processing-instruction pair is not used.
Header: none; a comment in serialize.h.
Owns: the d-o-e branches in src/xslt_lower_construct.c, and src/serialize_xml.c and src/serialize_html.c (the pair).
Size: about 3 KB, in the CLI only (the serializer is in sxml.wasm: under 1 KB there).

Gate: ≥ 90 % of the 32. Done 2026-10-19 (): disable-output-escaping 25 of 25 run pass (7 not run: 3 need streaming, 1 is XSLT 2.0 only, 3 need the feature absent), bug 4 more; XT40 8,759 to 8,784 passed, 0 errors, none lost (5 cases that need the feature absent are not run any more).
